title: Deeper/broader EvaluationGraph cross-implementation wire map and semantic boundary
scope: Compare Autodesk's semantic/API and generic DXF type references with LibreDWG's object map and ACadRust's independently implemented DXF writer sequence.
Reconcile ACadSharp implementation reports about undocumented fields and partial inference from exported DXF.
Update PAR-20/7G.3 readiness: wire sequence is testable locally; endpoint, sentinel, and graph-semantic validation remain gated.

sources.name: Autodesk AcDbEvalGraph ObjectARX reference
sources.evidence: Documents a directed acyclic dependency graph, unique node IDs, and topological evaluation order; ObjectARX edge APIs describe start/end nodes and invertible, directed, or suppressed metadata.
sources.limit: API/semantic contract; not a DXF group-code serialization map and does not map serialized repeated integers to endpoints or metadata.

sources.name: Autodesk ObjectARX Graphs guide
sources.evidence: Describes unique node IDs, reference counts, directed acyclic topology, and topological sorting.
sources.limit: Does not define DXF repeated-group meanings or nextid terminal values.

sources.name: Autodesk DXF Group Codes and Group Code Value Types Reference
sources.evidence: Groups 90-99 are 32-bit integers and 360-369 are hard-ownership object IDs; the companion value-types reference classifies 330-369 as object IDs.
sources.limit: Generic DXF storage/type definitions; not EvaluationGraph-specific field semantics, ownership policy, or proof that an object reference is a valid expression.

sources.name: LibreDWG OBJECTS manual
sources.evidence: Maps EvaluationGraph header, node, edge, and repeated group-code fields.
sources.limit: Implementation/manual crosswalk; does not settle every repeated-integer semantic or sentinel.

sources.name: LibreDWG current object-name stability table
sources.evidence: Current source classifies EVALUATION_GRAPH as UNSTABLE.
sources.limit: Mutable branch inspection dated 2026-10-20; no pinned source build was executed.

sources.name: ACadRust 0.5.5 crate/source
sources.evidence: Published package identity/version; separate Rust implementation from libdxfrw/LibreDWG.

sources.name: ACadRust DXF section writer
sources.evidence: Published 0.5.5 writer emits header 96/97; node 91/93/95/360 plus four 92 values; edge 92/93/94, two 91 values, and five 92 values.
sources.limit: Writer field names corroborate that implementation's model, not normative proof of semantic meaning. Docs.rs resolves to published 0.5.5 for this audit; current GitHub main Cargo.toml declares 0.6.5, whose writer source was not checked. No peer runtime or sample was exercised.

sources.name: ACadRust current GitHub main package manifest
sources.evidence: Current mutable main manifest declares package version 0.6.5; the current writer source reviewed in this pass emits the same EvaluationGraph group ordering as published 0.5.5.
sources.limit: Mutable branch source, not yet independently bound to the v0.6.5 release commit; no build, executable, or sample qualification was performed.

sources.name: ACadRust current GitHub main DXF writer source
sources.evidence: Current source writes EvaluationGraph header groups 96/97, node groups 91/93/95/360 with four 92 values, and edge groups 92/93/94 with two 91 and five 92 values.
sources.limit: Mutable main branch snapshot inspected 2026-10-20; no runtime or output artifact was produced, and its source was not independently fetched at the v0.6.5 commit.

sources.name: ACadRust v0.6.5 release identity
sources.evidence: The release page identifies v0.6.5 and points to commit 289a616da6c68518218594aa80802cbe7fa71309.
sources.limit: Release identity only; the exact tag's writer source was not fetched, built, or run in this pass.
